title: Report ssh-key write_openssh_file 0600 gap to RustCrypto/SSH
description: Upstream ssh-key (0.7.0-rc.12) also sets mode 0600 only on create; truncating an existing 0644 file keeps it world-readable. Fixed locally in 99b4ca2. File a single short, verified issue: see the rustcrypto-relations memory (April batch backlash).
